qc.label_under_test: a describing word placed directly before its noun in mid-sentence (not after 'is', not an adverb)

neighbours.label: two or more describing words stacked before a noun in expository prose, on the later modifier or the noun (the wider scientific community, the full creative design process); a single modifier fires less
fire: The findings were quickly accepted by the wider scientific community after several independent replications.
Researchers examined the full creative design process from early sketches to the final product.
The region's harsh continental climate limits agriculture to a short growing season.
Modern industrial economies depend on large complex supply networks that span several continents.
This article reviews the long-term economic consequences of rapid urban expansion.
The museum holds an extensive private ceramic collection assembled during the nineteenth century.
Many coastal towns face serious structural housing shortages as seasonal demand keeps rising.
The committee proposed a comprehensive national energy strategy aimed at reducing imports.
